name: web-fatis-homepage-problem-and-solution-before-after
title: Fati's homepage before/after: 'Problem' and 'Solution' frames with pink explanatory copy
whatItIs: An animated beige slide with two offset rounded frames: the old homepage (a plain photo banner and 'Popular' row) and the redesigned one (categories and a playful hero), each paired with a pink 'Problem' or 'Solution' heading and paragraph.
whatItMeans: Persuasive and honest; showing the old site next to the new makes the value of the redesign obvious.
techniques: Stagger before and after frames diagonally.
Pair each frame with a short labelled explanation.
Keep text in the brand colour on a neutral base.

vocabulary.definition: Showing an old and new version side by side.
A short description of what needed fixing.
